E1_confidence_certificate.question: Is the simultaneous-confidence certificate (24) non-vacuous on the released NASA cohort, and at which registration granularity?
E1_confidence_certificate.radius_rule: Bretagnolle-Huber-Carol: ||phat-p||_1 >= eps w.p. <= 2^K exp(-n eps^2/2); union bound over all extreme models of the registration; TV radius = eps/2
E1_confidence_certificate.delta_lower_rule: LP over the uncertainty-expanded families, not the Delta - 2*rho_max slack bound
declared_in_advance: Pooling members of a registration averages their one-unit laws weighted by n_steps, and sums their step counts.
A registration that is non-vacuous only because pooling collapsed Delta to near zero is NOT a success; both Delta and Delta_lower are reported for every registration.
No registration is added, removed, or reweighted after any outcome is seen.

E2_natural_collision_census.question: How close do the registered NASA models come to an exact cross-grade collision without one being constructed?
statistics: min pairwise TV over all safe x unsafe extreme pairs, overall and per policy
empirical CDF of pairwise TV at the 0.1, 1, 5 percent quantiles
declared_in_advance: This is an extremal statement about the registered empirical class. It is NOT an estimate of collision prevalence in any fleet.
The constructed adversarial collision already reported is excluded from this census.

prohibited: Reporting only the registration that gives the most favourable certificate.
Interpreting a small minimum pairwise TV as evidence that collisions are common.
Changing eta, the radius rule, or the registration list after seeing any outcome.
